content: Jesu Bethanyimaim Hiyanowah
Veya six nasasawar ufunamaim i Tar Nowaten ana veya, Jesu na Bethany tit, Lazarus morobone biyawas i ana bar merar.
Nati’imaim rabirab ana bay hibogaigiwas Jesu bairi aa isan, Martha ibaisih bairi bay hisemor. Lazarus orot afa auman Jesu bairi himarir gem sisibinamaim hima’am.

Raiy yamurin mamarin wabin nard i ai rourin hibun iroro’on hibai. Nati raiy iroro’on ana baiyan i gagamin na’in, Mary bai na isuwei ra’iy Jesu an rororon ihurufen, naatu aribunamaim safam. Naatu yamurin ana mamarin bar wanawanan etei itakwar.
Baise ana bai’ufununayan orot ta, Judas Iscariot boro ufibo baban nao, i eo,
“Ana gewasin iti raiy yamurin mamarin ana baiyan 300 silver coins
tatayai sabuw hitatubun naatu kabay tatab bai’akirayah tatibaisih.”
Iti tur eo’o, asir sabuw hinanot i akir sabuw baibaisih isah not eo hinarouw, baise i bainowan orot ta, anayabin hai kabay koukufet kakaif, abistan ekokok i ebai ana kokomaim esisinaf.
Jesu iya’afut eo, “Babin kwaihamiy! Abistan biyanamaim ema’am i ayu anamorob hinayaya’u isan eyayabuna.
Kwa boro mar etei akir sabuw wanawanahimaim kwanama, baise ayu boro men mar etei kwa bairit tanama’amih.”
Sabuw moumurin maiyow tur hinowar Jesu i na Bethany ma’am, imih sabuw Jesu itinamih hin, men i akisin itinamih hin baise Lazarus morobone Jesu biyawas auman itinamih hin.
Imih firis gagamih ef hinuwet hiyakitifuw Lazarus auman hitarab tamorob isan.
Anayabin Lazarus biyanamaim abistan matar hi’itin Jew sabuw moumurin maiyow himisir firis gagamih hikwahirih naatu Jesu isan higeger hitumitum.
Rou’ay Gagamin Jesu Ana Merar Hiyi Hibora’ara’ah Jerusalem Run
Marto sabuw rou’ay gagamin maiyow hiru’ay Tar Nowaten ana Hiyuw isan, tur hinowar Jesu i enan au Jerusalem.
Sabuw ai rourih hikakir naatu hitit hin Jesu nan bairi baitaramih, hitarkoukuw hi’o, “God tanifai! Regah wabinamaim enan, God nigegewasin! Israel hai aiwob inigegewasin!” Hitit hin bairi hitar.
Bobaituw boubun wabin donkey hitita’ur naatu afe’enamaim mara’at ma remor yen in. Buk Atamaninamaim hikirum hi’o na’atube.
Abistan nati ana veya himamatar ana bai’ufununayah men hiso’ob. Baise Jesu ana fair nabaib ufunamaim, imaibo hina’itin hinaso’ob. Buk Atamaninamaim i isan hi’o hikirum, naatu hisinafen himatar.
Sabuw iyab Jesu bairi hin rahemaim hitit Lazarus morobone yawas misir hi’i’itin hi’o tur ra’at tasasar.
Sabuw moumurin maiyow hitit hin Jesu biyan hitit, anayabin tur hinowar i ina’inan iti na’atube men tisinaf emamatar i sinaf matar.
Imih Pharisee taiyuwih himare hi’o, “It abistan tayayakitifuw men kafa’imo emamatar. Sabuw etei i’etaw tebi’ufunun kwa’i’itin!”
Greek Sabuw Afa Hikok Jesu Hita’itin
Greek sabuw afa wanawanahimaim bairi hiyen hin Jerusalem hiyuw ana veya imaim kwafirin isan.
Hina Philip biyan hitit, i Betsaida orot Galilee wanawanan, isan hifefeyan hi’o, “Aro, aki akokok Jesu ana’itin.”
Philip in Andrew ana tur eowen, naatu Andrew Philip hairi hin Jesu ana tur hi’owen.
Jesu iyafutih eo, “Orot Natun baifa’in naatu bora’ara’ahin isan ana veya na kabom.
Ayu turobe a tur ao’owen, sanabey tutufin ta’imon hinama’ub me yan hinataun na’inu’in, naatu nabikubobun boro moumurih na’in hinayen naatu ani’anin boro moumurih na’in naya.
Orot yait taiyuwin ana yawas ebiyabuw i boro yawas narusa’ir, naatu yait iti tafaramamaim taiyuwin ana yawas ekwakwahir boro nabotan yawas wanatowan isan.”
Yait ayu isou nabowabow, i ayu ni’ufnunu, naatu ayu menamaim ama’am au akir orot boro airi imaim anama. Yait ayu isou ebowabow Tamai boro nifai nabora’ara’ah.
“Ayu dogorou i yababan awan karatan, Tamai ayu boro mi’itube anao? Iti bai’akir ana veya iniyawasu? ‘Aiyabin, Tamai iti bai’akir ana veya nan anabaib isan ana atit.
Tamai o wab anabora’ah.” Naatu marane fanan tit eo, “Ayu wab abora’ahika naatu boro anabora’ah maiye.’”
Sabuw rou’ay nati’imaim hibatabat hinowar, afa hi’o, gunum rab naatu afa hi’o, “Tounamatar isan eo.”
Jesu eo, “Iti fanan i kwa isa eo, men ayu isou.
Veya boun iti tafaram baibabatiyin isan naatu iti tafaram ana aiwob boun boro hinabosair.
Baise Ayu iti tafaramamaim hinabobora’ahu anamaramaim, sabuw etei boro anabonawiyih hinan ayu akisu biyou hinatit.”
Iti tur eo, i mi’itube ti’obaiyih i ana morob ana itinin boro mi’itube namorob.
Sabuw hi’o, “Aki ofafaramaim anonowar Keriso boro nama wanatowan, naatu o mi’itube ku’o’o, Orot Natun boro hinabora’ah. Iti Orot Natunam yait?”
Naatu Jesu uwih eo, “Kwa mar kafai boro marakaw kwanab, marakaw kwabaibimaim kwanaremor, imaibo gugumin nan natarsumi. Orot yait guguminamaim ereremor i men so’ob menamaim enan.
Marakaw nati kwabai kwama’am a baitumatum i kwanitin. Saise kwa boro kwanan marakaw natunatun kwanamatar.” Iti eo’o ufunamaim, Jesu sabuw ihamiyih naatu i taiyuwin ibunwa’ir.
Jew Hai Koubibiruwen
Mensanet Jesu wanawanahimaim sawar faifirih imamataren, baise i boro’ika men tibitumitum.
Iti i mi’itube dinab orot Isaiah ana tur eo’o i titurobe isan. “Regah, yait aki tur a’o ebitumitum? Yait biyanamaim Regah ana fair ebirerereb?”
Anayabin iti isan, men karam hititumatum, imih Isaiah eo maiye;

content.text: naatu dogoroh rufoten, saise men hina’itin,
naatu hai not nakwaris anayabin boro men hinaso’ob.
naatu Regah eo, ayu isou boro men hinatatabir. Naatu tena ayu aniyawasih.”

content: Isaiah iti eo’o, anayabin Jesu ana marakaw itin naatu isan eo i nowar.
Naatu nati veya ta’imon wanawanan Jew ukwa’ukwarih wanawanahimaim Jesu hitumitum. Baise anayabin Pharisee isah hibir, men karam hai baitumatum hitao rereb, i boro kou’ay barene hitabotaitih.
Anayabin i orot babin isah tibiyabow men boun God isan tebiyabow na’atube.
Basit Jesu fanan aumetawat eo, “Orot ayu ebitutumu, i men ayu akisu ebitutumu, baise yait ayu iyafaru anan auman ebitumitum.
Yait ayu i’itu anamaramaim, ayu iyafaru anan auman i’itin.
Ayu i marakaw na’atube ana tafaramamaim atit, saise yait ayu ebitutumu i boro men guguminamaim nama.
Orot yait ayu au tur enonowar baise men ebaib, ayu boro men anibatiy. Ayu men tafaram fufuninamih ana atit, baise baiyawasinamih ana.
Yait ayu ebifutuwu naatu au tur men ebaib i ana baibatiyenayan ema’am. Tur iti ayu a’o i boro mar yomaninamaim nibabatiyi.
Anayabin ayu men taiyuwu au kokomaim ao’omih, baise Tamai ayu iyafaru anan tarbaiyunu tur abistanawat anao naatu boro mi’itube ana’o.
Naatu ayu aso’ob i ana tarbaiyunen tur boro nabonawiy inan ma’ama wanatowan. Imih ayu abistan ao’o i mutufor, Tamai uwu imih ao’o.”
